direction_scoring_asymmetric.problem: Applies proximity/recency/strength to LONG score only, not SHORT
direction_scoring_asymmetric.impact: Artificially inflates LONG score, biased direction determination
direction_scoring_asymmetric.fix_required: Apply distance decay to BOTH scores

double_liquidation_filtering.was: Fetched with ±2% expansion, never filtered after → 80% wasted data
double_liquidation_filtering.now: Strict liquidation range fetch only, no expansion, no waste

liquidation_range_too_restrictive.was: 40x leverage → ±1.2% range only, filtered valid $87k-$89k support, $92k-$94k resistance
liquidation_range_too_restrictive.now: 3x expanded range (±3.6%) for S/R discovery, sees all valid levels
liquidation_range_too_restrictive.rationale: Tight range good for SL/TP placement, wide range needed for market structure/breakout targets

cluster_size_filter_arbitrary.was: Required cluster_size >= 2, discarded strong single-touch levels
cluster_size_filter_arbitrary.now: Uses power >= threshold, keeps strong levels regardless of cluster size
cluster_size_filter_arbitrary.note: Already fixed before review, confirmed working

rr_hard_constraint.was: R:R ratio filtered TP candidates, rejected valid S/R levels
rr_hard_constraint.now: R:R used for position sizing only, all S/R levels accepted

circular_strategy_dependency.was: StrategyManager needed S/R to select strategy
circular_strategy_dependency.now: Strategy selection independent, uses volatility/trend/volume/RSI/pressure only

srp_violation_position_sizing.was: Position sizing logic duplicated in PredictionEngine and ReactiveEngine
srp_violation_position_sizing.now: Unified in PositionSizer module, both engines delegate

confidence_calculation.blocked_by: User wants all other fixes done first

stop_loss_liquidation_cap.problem: SL calculated based on ATR/S/R, doesn't check if beyond liquidation
